name: Install lint tools and golangci-lint in Docker env
description:
Install verification tools in the Docker environment so they're always available.

REQUIRED TOOLS:

1. goimports
   - go install golang.org/x/tools/cmd/goimports@latest
   - Binary location: $(go env GOPATH)/bin/goimports
   - Used for: Code formatting + import organization

2. gofumpt  
   - go install mvdan.cc/gofumpt@latest
   - Binary location: $(go env GOPATH)/bin/gofumpt
   - Used for: Strict code formatting (superset of gofmt)

3. golangci-lint v2.11.4 (CRITICAL - NOT v1)
   - Install via curl (NOT go install):
     curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/golangci/golangci-lint/HEAD/install.sh | sh -s -- -b $(go env GOPATH)/bin v2.11.4
   - Binary location: $(go env GOPATH)/bin/golangci-lint
   - Reason for curl: go install can use unexpected dependency versions, producing untested binaries
   - Required version: v2.x because .golangci.yml uses v2 format
   - Enables revive linter with 'exported' rule (catches missing GoDoc comments)

VERIFICATION COMMANDS (run before EVERY commit):

# Format check (exact commands from CI):
find . -name "*.go" -not -path "./.cache/*" -not -path "./.gomodcache/*" -not -path "./.go/*" -not -path "./vendor/*" -not -path "./.tempgomod/*" -exec goimports -l {} \;
find . -name "*.go" -not -path "./.cache/*" -not -path "./.gomodcache/*" -not -path "./.go/*" -not -path "./vendor/*" -not -path "./.tempgomod/*" -exec gofumpt -l {} \;

# Full lint:
golangci-lint run ./...

# Tests:
make test

DOCUMENTATION:
- Design-Decisions.md line 107: golangci-lint v2.11.4 (installed via curl)
- Design-Decisions.md line 119-121: goimports + gofumpt formatting order
- .golangci.yml: v2 format with revive exported rules

name: Implement liquidity-pulse: TDD workflow (orchestration)

Orchestration task for implementing liquidity-pulse in TDD order. Work through the 7 sub-tasks sequentially. For each:
  1. Write failing test(s) first
  2. Run make test — confirm test fails for the right reason
  3. Implement just enough code to pass
  4. Run make test + make lint — confirm clean
  5. Commit with message scoped to the task
  6. Stop and wait for user to say 'continue' before moving to next task

Sub-tasks in order:
  fpbxvybr — lp-1: Define Data and Classification types
  h24tofs7 — lp-2: Update Def() to declare both endpoints
  mh3k362q — lp-3: Parse CoinGecko response; compute ratio and classify
  fktw8ddj — lp-4: Cross-source validation against Binance BTC volume
  y6rrij8i — lp-5: Wire DetectStatus to set MetricResult.Status
  kg2ecgnr — lp-6: Assemble MetricResult with data and conditional meta
  vqbk3a38 — lp-7: E2E integration test for liquidity-pulse CLI command

Notes:
- Tasks lp-3 through lp-6 all modify Compute() in the same file. Between steps the function will be partially implemented — use placeholder returns so the file compiles between commits.
- lp-2 (Def endpoints) must come before lp-4 (Binance validation) since the data map only contains keys for declared endpoints.
- lp-7 test can be written before lp-6 is complete; it will fail until Compute() is fully wired.
- Source of truth for implementation: docs/metrics/liquidity-pulse.md, Design-Decisions.md Steps 12+14, CLAUDE.md Metric Conventions.
